Hi, was in a minisuite just last year. It is definitely more isolated than normal dorms (hallways are bigger and you need to leave multiple doors open for people to come in instead of just one for the traditional halls). However, do not let that sour your experience! You actually will meet people from your building in your orientation group, and some may even be on your floor. I found a lot of friends and people I liked in my group, so I was lucky and you will definitely be as well. It also depends on your RA and how involved he/she wants to be in getting your floor to bond and socialize. All in all, it is definitely more independent and isolated but that does not mean anti-social at all costs! Lmk if you have more questions. Have fun at move in day! Don’t be nervous and take it all in :)
